item.title: On slow software
item.description: Field notes on slow software: why the tools that age best are the ones that do less, refuse dependencies & ship a smaller surface area. I spent the month rebuilding my reading pipeline by hand — RSS, a cron job, one JSON file — and it taught me more about durability than any framework migration ever has. Plus: three links worth your weekend, and a short argument for owning your own archive.
item.dc:creator: Alan Tai
